title: The Keeper of Wend Light
tagline: A lighthouse, a storm, and a promise kept by lamplight.
synopsis: Mara is fourteen, the keeper has gone to the mainland, and the almanac on the kitchen table says the lamp must never go dark. Then the barometer starts to fall. A short Quick Book in three chapters — written in Markdown, compiled by Storyframe, and the reference example for every directive in docs/BOOK-AUTHORING.md.
